architectureDecision.reason: Required after two-pass applicability review: the approved scope introduces a second Astro route, URL-carried plan intent across routes, shared countdown behavior, native-form validation orchestration, and browser-local IndexedDB transaction/error/concurrency ownership into a repository that currently contains only the Astro starter. These are meaningful routing, shared-state, persistence, accessibility, and test-boundary decisions. Standard remains sufficient because there is no backend, authentication, service integration, migration, deployment change, or multi-runtime trust boundary.
